प्र-˚राध्य mfn. to be satisfied or made content, RV. v, 39, 3.
प्र-√ री P. -रिणाति, to sever, detach, take away, RV. ii, 22, 4; Ā. -रीयते, to penetrate, enter (?), v, 7, 8.

m: प्र-˚रूढ mfn. grown up, full-grown, R.; Kāv.; Var.
(ifc.) overgrown with, Hariv.
filled up, healed up, R.
grown, widely spread, become great or strong, Sāh.; BhP.; Kathās. &c.
old, L.
growing or proceeding from a root, rooted, fastened, L.
arisen or proceeded from (comp.), Hariv.; R.; Śak.; BhP.
a: प्ररूढ — p. p. 1 Full-grown, developed. --2 Born, sprung, produced; यस्यायमंगात् कृतिनः प्ररूढः Ś. 7. 19. --3 Increased. --4 Gone deep, rooted; as in प्ररूढमूल. --5 Grown long; as in प्ररूढकेश, प्ररूढश्मश्रु.

m: प्र-˚रूढ—शालि m. full-grown rice, MW.
प्र-˚रूढ—कक्ष mfn. a place where shrubs have grown, ĀpŚr.
प्र-˚रूढ—केश mfn. one whose hair has grown long, having l˚ h˚, Pañcat.
प्र-˚रूढ—मूल mfn. having roots gone deep, A.
प्र-˚रूढि f. the having shot up, Hcar.
growth, increase, Rājat.
प्र-√ रूप् P. -रूपयति, to expound, expose, explain (esp. in the Jaina system), Sarvad.
प्र-˚रूपण nf. exposing, teaching, Siṃhās.

v: avya॰ pragatI raTI yatra tizWadgu॰ avyayI॰ । pragataraTayukte deSe ।

m: प्र-रथम् ind. g. तिष्ठद्ग्व्-आदि.
प्र-√ रद् P. -रदति, to scratch or cut in, dig out (as a channel), mark out (as a path), RV.
प्र-√ रक्ष् P. -रक्षति, to protect against, save from (abl.; see -रक्षित below).
प्र-˚रक्ष mfn. one from whom any one is protected, Siddh.
प्र-˚रक्षण n. protecting, protection, Pañcat.
प्र-˚रक्षित mfn. protected against, saved from (abl.), Pañcat. (v.l.)
प्र-√ रम् Caus. P. -रमयति, to delight or gladden greatly, exhilarate, Nir. ii, 18.
प्र-√ रप् P. -रपति, to prate, talk, RV.
प्र-√ रप्श् (only Ā. pf. -ररप्शे), to reach beyond (abl.), RV.
प्रर्च्छक mfn. (fr. प्र + ऋच्छक), Pat.
प्र-√ रेज् Ā. -रेजते, to tremble at (acc.), RV. i, 38, 10 : Caus. -रेजयति, to cause to tremble, ib. iv, 22, 3.
प्र-˚रेक, m. (iii, 30, 19) and प्र-˚रेचन, n. (i, 17, 6) abundance, plenty, RV.
प्र-रेक , ˚रेचन. See प्र-√ रिच्.
प्र-√ रिच् Ā. -रिच्यते, to excel, surpass, be superior to (abl.), RV.; TS.; to empty excessively, become ex˚ empty, TĀr. : Caus. -रेचयति, to leave remaining, RV.; to quit, abandon, ib.

v: tri॰ pra + rica--Nvanip । prakarzeRa virecanakarttari f॰ 1 । 10 । 15 ।

m: प्र-˚रिक्वन् mfn. reaching beyond, surpassing (with abl.), RV. i, 100, 15.
प्र-र्क्षीय Nom. P. ˚यति (fr. प्रर्क्ष = प्र + ऋक्ष), Vop. ii, 4; (also प्रार्क्षीय.)
प्र-˚रोधन n. rising, ascending, TS.
प्र-˚रोचना f. highest praise, Bālar.
(in dram.) exciting interest by praising an author in the prologue of a drama, Daśar.; Sāh.; Pratāp. (also n.)
favourable description of that which is to follow in a play, ib.

m: प्र-˚रोचन mf(ई)n. exciting or inciting to love (as a spell), seductive, Kathās.
प्र-˚रोचन n. stimulating, exciting, Mālatīm.
seduction, Prab.
praising, ChUp.; Śaṃk.; Kap., Sch.; Mālatīm.
illustration, explanation, PañcavBr.
a: प्ररोचन — a. Exciting or enticing. --नं 1 Exciting, or stimulating. --2 Illustration, explanation. --3 Seduction. --4 Exhibition (of a person) for being seen and liked (by the people); अलोकसामान्यगुणस्तनूजः प्ररोचनार्थं प्रकटीकृतश्च Māl. 1. 10 (where Jagaddhara interprets प्ररोचनार्थं by प्रवृत्तिपाटवार्थं ‘in order to be thoroughly acquainted with the world’). --5 Favourable description of that which is to follow in a play. --6 Representation of the end as all but accomplished; see S. D. 388; (प्ररोचना also in the last two senses).

m: प्र-˚रोचित mfn. (fr. Caus.) commended, praised, approved, liked, MBh.

m: प्र-˚रोह m. germinating, sprouting, growing or shooting forth (lit. and fig.; cf. दृढप्˚), Kum.; Kull. &c.
a bud, shoot, sprout, sprig, Hariv.; Kāv.; Suśr. &c.
an excrescence, Suśr.
a new leaf or branch, MW.
(fig.) a shoot = ray (of light; see प्रभा-प्˚), Kum.; Ragh.; BhP.
a: प्ररोहः — 1 Sprouting, shooting or growing up, germination; as in यवांकुरप्ररोहः. --2 A sprout, shoot (fig. also); प्लक्षप्ररोह इव सौधतलं बिभेद R. 8. 93; प्लक्षान् प्ररोहजटिलानिव मंत्रिवृद्धान् 13. 71; Ku. 5. 60; 7. 17; 5. 60; U. 5. 2. --3 A scion, offspring; हा राधेयकुलप्ररोह Ve. 4; Mv. 6. 25; नंदवंशप्ररोहः Mu. 1. 11. --4 A shoot of light; कुर्वंति सामंतशिखामणीनां प्रभाप्ररोहास्तमयं रजांसि R. 6. 33. --5 A new leaf or branch, twig, spray. --6 An excrescence.

m: प्र-˚रोहण n. germinating, sprouting, growing or shooting forth, growth (lit. and fig.), MBh.; Sāṃkhyak., Sch.; Siṃhās.
a bud, shoot, sprig, MBh.; Hariv.
a: प्ररोहणं — 1 Growing, shooting forth, germination. --2 Budding, sprouting. --3 A twig, sprout, shoot, spray.

m: प्र-˚रोहक mfn. causing to grow, Nalac.
प्र-˚रोह—वत् mfn. possessing vegetation, covered with v˚, Suśr.
प्र-˚रो˚हि-शाखिन् mfn. (a tree) whose branches grow again, Yājñ. ii, 227.
प्र-˚रोहिन् mfn. growing or shooting up, sh˚ up from (comp.), Mn. i, 46
(ifc.) causing to grow, propagating, MBh.; Hariv.; Hcat.
a: प्ररोहिन् — a. 1 Shooting up. --2 Growing, propagated; Ms. 1. 46.

m: प्र-˚रोपित mfn. (fr. Caus.) sown, planted, R.; Sāh.
shown or done (as a kindness), Rājat.
प्र-√ रु P. -रौति, to roar or cry out loudly, RV.
प्र-√ रुध् P. Ā. -रुणद्धि, -रुन्द्धे, to keep or hold back, check, stop, Br.; MBh.
प्र-√ रुच् Ā. -रोचते, to shine forth, RV.; to be liked, please, ŚBr. : Caus. -रोचयति, to enlighten, illuminate, RV.; to cause to shine, ib.; to make apparent or specious, make pleasing, AV.; TS.; Br.
a: प्ररुच् — {c1c} A. 1 To shine very much. --2 To be liked.

m: प्र-√ रुद् P. -रोदिति, to begin to mourn or cry or weep, lament or cry aloud, ŚāṅkhGṛ.; MBh.; R. &c.; to weep with any one (acc.), MBh.
प्र-˚रुदित mfn. one who has begun to weep, weeping, MBh.; R.; Vikr.; Kathās.
a: प्ररुदित — p. p. Crying bitterly, weeping.

m: प्र-√ रुह् P. -रोहति, to grow up, shoot forth, shoot up, VS.; Br.; ChUp. &c.; to heal up (as a wound), MBh. (v.l.); to grow, increase, MBh.; Rājat.; ŚārṅgP. : Caus. -रोपयति, to fasten to, put into or on (loc.), Var.
प्र-˚रुह् mfn. shooting forth, growing up (like a plant)
प्र-˚रुह् m. (with गिरि) a mountain which rises in the foreground, Hariv. 5327
प्र-˚रुह् f. a shoot, a new branch, AV.
a: प्ररुह् — {c1c} P. 1 To grow, rise, shoot forth; न पर्वताग्रे नलिनी प्ररोहति Mk. 4. 17. --2 To heal up (as a wound).
प्ररुह् — f. Ved. A shoot, branch.

m: प्र-√ रुज् P. -रुजति, to break down, break, RV.; MBh.; BhP.

m: प्र-˚रुज m. N. of a mythical being conquered by Garuḍa, MBh.
of a Rākṣasa, ib.
प्रर्षभीय Nom. P. ˚यति (fr. प्रर्षभ = प्र + ऋषभ), Pāṇ. vi, 1, 22, Sch.; (also प्रार्षभीय.)
